what: Null residuals of the engine's amp envelope (param: the Blink AudioParam timeline port; adsr: getADSRValues/getParamADSR) against the Chromium micro-case references, and the thresholds derived from them.
residual: 20*log10(rms(chromium - engine) / rms(chromium)) over every sample of both channels, no alignment search
marginRule: threshold = measured residual rounded up by about 3 dB; a bit-exact case (-inf) gets -140 dB (far below the -60 dB target, above the level of a stray 1-ulp float difference)

adsr-long-attack.notes: s('one') (constant 1): the envelope itself. a > dur shape. Bit-identical to Chromium.

adsr-short-hap.notes: s('one'), a + d > dur shape, one onset at 2756.25 frames (between frames) and one at 11025. Bit-identical to Chromium.

param-linear-ramp.notes: s('one'), every ramp end between frames: pins Blink's float k = 1/dt and x = (t - t1) * k rounding, ceil(t * sr) event frames, the gainNode(1) setValueAtTime at the pause time. Bit-identical to Chromium.

adsr-attack-only.notes: Sine source: the residual is the interim oscillator (analytic libm::sin vs Chromium's table sine, as osc-sine at -93.75 dB), not the envelope, which the s('one') cases show to be exact. Stage 7 (periodic waves) re-measures.
adsr-attack-only.superseded: The periodic-wave stage replaced the interim sine and re-measured: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json (bit-identical, -140 dB)

adsr-sustain-only.superseded: The periodic-wave stage replaced the interim sine and re-measured: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json (bit-identical, -140 dB)

adsr-decay-only.notes: Sine source; decay only gives sustain 0.001 (getADSRValues). As adsr-attack-only.
adsr-decay-only.superseded: The periodic-wave stage replaced the interim sine and re-measured: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json (bit-identical, -140 dB)

adsr-defaults.notes: Sine source, default envelope [0.001, 0.05, 0.6, 0.01]; unchanged from the interim envelope (-102.85 dB); no longer interim. As adsr-attack-only.
adsr-defaults.superseded: The periodic-wave stage replaced the interim sine and re-measured: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json (bit-identical, -140 dB)

deferred.param-exp-ramp: No control implemented at this stage schedules an exponential ramp (the amp envelope is always linear; the pitch, filter and FM envelopes are stages 7 to 9). Deferred to stage 7 (pitch envelope with pcurve 1); the exponential ramp is covered by param unit tests and the adsr.json getParamADSR vectors until then. Done: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json.
deferred.param-exp-held: Same reason; deferred to stage 7 (a pitch envelope whose exponential ramp crosses or touches 0). Done: evidence/engine-null-micro-oscillators.json.
